user_decisions.text: Drawer-open-v2 calibration - choose Option 1: documented, task-specific override. I authorize a narrowly scoped override of G1 (8.77 mm vs. 8 mm) and G5b (0.099 px vs. 0.05 px), provided a short read-only sensitivity analysis finds no substantial geometric or downstream impact. Examine the G1 workspace reprojection impact and G5b's nine high-offset episodes. Preserve all 98 episodes. Do not exclude outliers merely to pass acceptance. Preserve the original failed verdicts, numerical evidence, and calibration provenance. Record both exceptions explicitly; do not weaken global acceptance thresholds or claim automatic acceptance passed. If the impact check reveals a significant problem, keep the calibration held and report the evidence rather than overriding it. Otherwise, publish the unchanged rig under the explicit override and immediately resume Phase B, dataset publication, Ours/baseline pretraining, FQL, and all dependent S-only jobs. Keep real-robot execution authorization separate from this calibration override.

user_decisions.kind: explicit override (Option 2), made with the failed sensitivity result in view; this decision authorizes the override
user_decisions.text: Proceed with Option 2: override drawer-open-v2 only. The measured calibration errors are acceptable for offline training. Preserve all 98 episodes, 3 cameras, original failure records, thresholds, and evidence hashes. Implement a narrowly scoped override without weakening global acceptance criteria. Immediately proceed with Phase B, publication, pretraining, FQL, and evaluation as dependencies become ready. Avoid unnecessary delays or redundant verification. Keep physical robot execution subject to separate safety and eligibility gates. Preserve all existing jobs, checkpoints, and configurations.
